name: adapt-grow-glossary
summary: Glossary passage: a block of prose with inline marked terms; selecting a term reveals its definition in a brand-coloured region below. Completes when every term has been opened.

fill.note: The marker uses --ab-base-accent (mapped to --accent by grow-ab-bridge.less); the definition region is painted with --h1 (deep brand navy) carrying --surface-1 text, so it inverts correctly in dark mode. Hover/focus tints use color-mix() at the call sites because darken()/fade() cannot take a var().
